name: Inductive proximity sensor level shifter (isolated)
hazard_basis: 12-24 V DC SELV field input, fuse-limited (PPTC 0.5 A hold, 30 V rating), no mains, no stored energy beyond 2.3 uF. Functional (not safety) isolation, working voltage <= 30 V DC. No fabrication hold on hazard grounds; physical qualification still required before use.
generator: tools/make_contract.py (single source; rerun instead of editing this JSON by hand)
function: Translates one qualified three-wire 10-30 V DC inductive proximity sensor (PNP or NPN output, selected by solder jumper SJ2) into one standard Smoothie endstop/probe signal. The sensor field side (own 12-24 V supply) is galvanically separated from the host (endstop S/G/5V cable) by TLP291 optocouplers. The output behaves like a normally-closed endstop to host ground: LOW = field healthy and sensor idle, RELEASED (host pull-up high) = triggered OR field power lost OR sensor/cable fault.
scope: Single board, one sensor, one output connector, no Gadgeteer socket (design.md: no Gadgeteer interface), no firmware. Supported matrix: 3-wire DC, NPN (sinking) or PNP (sourcing) output selected by SJ2 (shipped NPN), NO or NC output selected by SJ1 (shipped NO); off-state leakage <= 20 uA, residual voltage <= 2 V, supply 10-30 V, load current >= 5 mA. Unsupported (marked on silkscreen/README): 2-wire sensors, AC or AC/DC sensors, NAMUR, push-pull (complementary) outputs, analog outputs, sensors drawing >200 mA, 5 V sensors. This contract replaces the missing ai-build-brief.md.

maintainer_decisions.decision: Board name: level shifter, not 'proximity sensor' (footnote [t]). Slug unchanged (README index key); silkscreen/title use 'INDUCTIVE SENSOR LEVEL SHIFTER'.
Design for 12-24 V (footnote [t]) = operating 10.8-26.4 V at J1; absolute continuous 30 V (PPTC Vmax and TVS VRWM); reverse connection up to 30 V survivable.
maintainer_decisions.evidence: specs.md; Littelfuse 1812L050/30 Vmax 30 V; SMF30CA VRWM 30 V

maintainer_decisions.decision: Same functional idea as the V2 Prime protected probe input (footnote [u]) but not a copy: the opto changes the ground model; the native comparator circuit is rated 3-45 V and shares ground, this board is isolated and rated 10.8-26.4 V.

resolved_items.resolution: See supported_sensor_matrix. PNP/NPN is selected by 3-pad solder jumper SJ2 (centre pad = SENSOR_IN, so exactly one of two opto LED branches is ever connected); NO/NC by SJ1. Auto-sensing both polarities without a jumper was REJECTED after a netlist-level DC check: two LED branches on one floating OUT node form a series path VF -> LED -> OUT -> LED -> GF that conducts with the sensor off (original defect, caught by review, now guarded by the DC solver in make_contract.py). SJ1 mismatch is visible and fail-safe (idle reads triggered). SJ2 mismatch is NOT detected: the wrong branch never conducts, so on the NO position a target is never reported (SIG stays LOW) - residual risk, mitigated by silkscreen, amber LED check and the first-power procedure (Q-mismatch). Push-pull outputs unsupported.

Two named domains FIELD (VIN_RAW, VIN_F, VF, GF, SENSOR_IN + derived) and HOST (SIG, GND_H, +5V_H, GATE + derived). No net, pour, hole, shield or connector joins them (self-checked in make_contract.py). Output polarity: SIG LOW = idle and healthy; SIG released = triggered or fault. Host provides the pull-up (native Prime2590: 10 k to selected 5 V/3.3 V).

Transient environment: ESD handling and light industrial wiring; TVS 30 V standoff / 48.4 V clamp at 4.1 A (10/1000 us), no surge/EFT claim beyond that. Timing: board adds <= 250 us (opto toff typ 60 us with storage plus gate RC 9 us, worst-case budget); native host RC (100 nF with 10 k pull-up, ~1 ms) dominates; sensor events <= 1 kHz.

gadgeteer_socket.statement: None. The board has no Gadgeteer 2x5 socket and no chain port. Its only host interface is the 3-pin 2.54 mm S/G/5V endstop connector J3 (CLAUDE.md 'Single input / endstop pinout'). CLAUDE.md pin 1 = +3.3V / pin 2 = +5V / pin 10 = GND therefore does not apply; the stale 'conflicting web ordering' note in research.md is moot and is NOT propagated (native schematics agree with the canonical table per additional-endstop-inputs-breakout evidence).

endstop_connector.viewing: from above (component side), pin 1 marked; plug entry upward (vertical KK 254).
endstop_connector.native_prime_cable_note: Native Prime2590 J24-J29 are pad1 power, pad2 GND, pad3 FIELD: a straight 1:1 cable connects board SIG to host power. Use a cable that crosses pins 1 and 3, or confirm the host header pinout; printed on silkscreen.

gadgeteer_socket.external_power_rule: EXCEPTION to the CLAUDE.md '12-24 V input also sourceable from Gadgeteer 5V' rule: no such jumper. A 10-30 V inductive sensor cannot run from 5 V, so a jumper would invite a non-working or unsafe configuration; DESIGN-RULES 'Supply choice' permits a documented exception when the function requires the higher voltage. Logged in questions.md.

supported_sensor_matrix.target: OUT sinks to 0V, DN lit, SIG RELEASED
OUT sources to +V, DP lit, SIG RELEASED

supported_sensor_matrix.idle: OUT sinks, DN lit, SIG LOW
OUT sources, DP lit, SIG LOW

supported_sensor_matrix.note: Wrong SJ1 (NO/NC) is visible and fail-safe: idle reads RELEASED (triggered). Wrong SJ2 (NPN/PNP) is NOT detected: neither LED lights, S_ON is never true; on SJ1 NC the SIG stays RELEASED (visible), on SJ1 NO the SIG stays LOW (target never reported, UNSAFE for a Z probe). Required mitigation: before first use wave metal at the sensor and confirm that exactly the selected-type amber LED lights (NPN: OUT LOW, PNP: OUT HIGH). Detectability of faults: field power loss reads RELEASED in all positions; a broken sensor wire or dead sensor reads RELEASED only for NC sensors on SJ1 NC (sensor idle = conducting); for NO sensors the sensor-off state is the idle state, so sensor-side cable breaks are NOT detectable. NC sensor + SJ1 NC is the fully fail-safe combination.

domains.rule: No copper, via, pour, mask opening, silkscreen-bridged pad, mounting-hole barrel or hardware tie joins the domains. FIELD and HOST copper stay >= 4.9 mm apart everywhere (the optocoupler pad-to-pad gap).

power_budget.host_5v: Consumes only the RS/pTr_ok feed (<= 0.1 mA) and phototransistor leakage; the shared ~3 A regulator and unknown per-connector allocation are irrelevant at that magnitude (stated, not assumed).

calculations.inrush_note: Peak is set by source/cable impedance plus PPTC initial resistance (Rmin 0.15 ohm; 1.0 ohm is the post-trip R1max); stored energy 0.5*2.3uF*26.4V^2 = 0.8 mJ, harmless
calculations.ok_channel_note: U3 runs at 0.74 mA at VF_min (below the 1 mA point where CTR_sat is guaranteed) but only has to pass the 23 uA RS feed (needs CTR >= ~3 percent)

assumptions: A-SAT: sensor output residual voltage <= 2.0 V at the LED current (typ. inductive sensors 0.5-2 V)
Host pull-up <= 0.5 mA when SIG is LOW (native 10 k to 5 V)

J1_field_power.result: D1 blocks; TVS1 (30 V standoff) and F1 carry no current; board dark; POWER LED off
NOT protected (TVS clamps at 48.4 V and may fail short; F1 then opens). Outside the declared envelope; no sustained-overvoltage cutoff fitted (decision, questions.md)

J1_field_power.result: F1 trips (Ih 0.5 A, It 1.0 A; hold 0.33 A at 70 C); PPTC stays conductive at ~0.1 mA tripped state and cools on removal

J2_sensor.result: No hazard to the board: any single permutation limits LED currents by RN/RP/RLN/RLP (<= 8 mA at 26 V), LED reverse stress <= 2 V (TLP291 VR 5 V). A sensor wired reversed may be damaged unless it has reverse protection; the board's F1 limits the current.
Looks like PNP ON or NPN ON: limited to <= 8 mA per branch
No ESD diode fitted on SENSOR_IN (decision A-ESD): series RN/RP and the opto LED take it; unverified exposure
J2_sensor.recovery: add a TVS on SENSOR_IN if qualification shows failures

J3_host.result: SIG meets host 5 V and +5V_H meets the host FIELD pin: no damage (Q1 50 V, pTr 80 V, Ioff of the host buffer), but no function

J3_host.fault: host power off, field power on
J3_host.result: SIG released; the only host-side current is pTr leakage

protection.tvs_failure_mode: TVS1 failing short is cleared by F1 (placed upstream of TVS1).

host_interface.pullup_requirement: Host must provide the SIG pull-up (native Prime2590: 10 k to selected 5 V or 3.3 V). The board adds none.
host_interface.firmware_polarity: Treat as a normally-closed endstop to ground: idle LOW, triggered HIGH. Smoothieware pin config example with pull-up and the usual inversion modifiers is a firmware matter and is not changed here (no firmware scope).

board_specific_rules: No net, pour, via or hole joins FIELD and HOST; no track crosses the isolation band.
J3.1 SIG is never driven high by the board.
SJ1 pad 2 (SIG) is the common pad; no other connection of SIG exists except J3.1 and TP_SIG.
TVS1 is connected after F1 and before D1; D1 is in the positive feed only; GF is continuous.
Each opto LED has its own series resistor (RN, RP, ROK); SENSOR_IN reaches exactly one of N_K (U1/DN) or P_A (U2/RLP) through SJ2, never both.
SJ2 pad 2 is the only SENSOR_IN connection besides J2.3 and TP_SENS.
ROK/DPWR labelled POWER and nothing else.
No part other than J1 sits before F1.

Pin 1 = cathode = VF (series reverse-polarity element in the positive feed); pin 2 = anode = VIN_F. Check pad 1 = K in the KiCad footprint (D_SOD-123F pad 1 is cathode).

Amber/yellow LED. KiCad LED pin 1 = cathode, pin 2 = anode: cathode on N_K (the NPN side of SJ2), anode on LN_A. Datasheet not retrieved (A-LED).
Cathode on GF, anode on LP_A (KiCad LED pin 1 = cathode).
Green. Cathode OK_B (to U3 anode), anode OK_A. Labelled POWER, never READY.
LED side (pins 1,2) north = FIELD, detector side (pins 3,4) south = HOST. Rotation 270 verified to put pads 1 and 2 at y = 20.55 and pads 3, 4 at y = 27.05.

Shipped: pads 1-2 bridged = NO (SIG driven by Q1). Cut the trace and bridge pads 2-3 for NC (SIG driven directly by the phototransistors). Pad 2 is the common SIG pad, so the two states are mutually exclusive by construction.

Signal, Ground, 5V (CLAUDE.md endstop standard). Keyed/polarised KK 254. Native Prime2590 endstop headers are pad1 power, pad2 GND, pad3 FIELD, so a straight cable crosses SIG and 5V (README note, silk).

Shipped: pads 1-2 bridged = NPN (sensor OUT sinks to 0V when on). Cut the trace and bridge pads 2-3 for PNP (sensor OUT sources to +V). Pad 2 is the common SENSOR_IN pad: only one branch is ever connected to the sensor, so with the sensor output high-Z no current path VF -> GF exists (netlist DC solver check).
